summary: A Quote subscription on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX): the detailed packet of an index becomes an index Quote frame with the change worked out from the previous close.

notes: An index's detailed packet carries no trade quantity, book or OI; the web sends those zeros, the desktop leaves them out. Whether Pocketful streams indices with the detailed layout needs a live check.

deviations.reason: Pocketful's compact and detailed packets carry the last trade time (last_traded_time, epoch seconds, packet_decoder.py); the web's frames leave it out since a1d539764 (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_compact_data, _handle_detailed_data): market data the broker sent, lost. The desktop sends it as ltt in epoch milliseconds, the unit the docs give every WebSocket time.

An index's detailed packet fills the last trade quantity, the best bid and ask with their sizes and the OI with 0, values an index does not have; the web sends those zeros (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_detailed_data), the desktop leaves them out.
